note: Real. Malik Nabers (NYG) hurt his right knee leaping for a deep ball in the second quarter against the Chargers, Week 4 (Sep 28, 2025), and was carted off. A torn ACL was feared Sunday, and Monday's MRI confirmed it; Daboll said he was out for the rest of the season, and he went on IR Monday. news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Ian Rapoport, NFL Network)
news.words: Nabers is believed to have suffered a torn ACL Sunday against the Chargers. Nabers has been ruled out for the remainder of the contest.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Adam Schefter, ESPN)
news.words: Nabers is slated for an MRI on his right knee Monday to determine if he indeed suffered a torn ACL. He grabbed at his right knee and remained on the turf before being carted off the field.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Dianna Russini, The Athletic, and Adam Schefter, ESPN)
news.words: Nabers (knee) suffered a season-ending torn right ACL in Sunday's win over the Chargers. The nature of the injury was confirmed Monday via an MRI.

news.source: Brian Daboll, press conference (AP via FOX Sports)
news.words: Malik Nabers has a torn ACL in his right knee and the New York Giants' top wide receiver is out for the rest of the season, coach Brian Daboll said Monday.

The Giants had their worst fears confirmed Monday with an MRI showing that Nabers suffered a season-ending torn ACL in his right knee, coach Brian Daboll announced. He was officially placed on injured reserve later Monday.
